title: Phone speaks every reply in the project's Genlock voice, captions a sentence at a time

requirements.text: The bridge (mobile/bridge/bridge.mjs) asks the speaker for each walk item's 'say' in that item's project voice and sends the m4a clips to the phone tagged with item id and sentence index, alongside the reply
requirements.check: mobile/bridge/test case: a reply with 2 items produces clip messages for both item ids

requirements.text: Walker.kt plays an item's clips in order (MediaPlayer) instead of TextToSpeech, and the caption shows the sentence being played
requirements.check: eye: TJ hears a walk on the Pixel in the Genlock voice, caption moving sentence by sentence

requirements.text: Two items from different projects are read in different voices when their projects' voices differ
requirements.check: eye: TJ hears two projects' items on the Pixel in two voices

requirements.text: If an item's clips have not arrived within 8 seconds the phone falls back to its built-in voice for that item and says nothing is broken
requirements.check: manual: stop the speaker, walk an item, built-in voice reads it

requirements.text: The app builds and its JVM tests pass; bridge tests pass

text: Not started; needs T-NC7TA's speaker. Bridge: mobile/bridge/bridge.mjs onReply has items with project; files.mjs chunksFor carries binaries. Phone: Walker.kt speakCurrent uses tts().speak.

evidence: mobile/bridge/test/voicing.test.mjs 'a reply with 2 items produces clip messages for both item ids' passes; real speaker smoke: s-0 (genlock, af_sarah) 2 clips + done, s-1 (ghostlight, bm_lewis) 2 clips + done, late:<project> lines after

text: Bridge voicing.mjs + Walker clip player + Clips.kt built; bridge 32 tests and JVM 10 tests pass. Fixed British voices (espeak lang 'en', not 'en-gb': every bm/bf voice failed before). Next: install APK on Pixel, restart bridge, TJ listens.

evidence: gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug: ClipsTest 3/0 fail, WalkPlanTest 7/0 fail, APK built and installed on Pixel 10 Pro (Success); bridge node --test 32 pass 0 fail

text: APK on Pixel, bridge restarted with voicing. Left for TJ: hear a walk (2), two projects in two voices (3), fallback (4).

Phone now makes the voice itself (T-K34H3), so its clips replace the Mac's. 20:41 walk: all items in the Genlock voice, TJ confirmed. Left: req 3, two projects in two voices heard by TJ; req 4, fallback when the model is absent.
